title: Locnville Reunion: Brothers Back in the Groove | News24
text:
Locnville Brothers Chart New Course with Musical Reunion
A return to creative collaboration marks a significant moment for the South African music scene as the Locnville brothers are reuniting and rediscovering their musical synergy. After a period of individual pursuits, the duo is poised to release new music and reignite their connection with fans, signaling a fresh chapter in their celebrated career.
The popular South African musical duo, Locnville, comprised of brothers Andrew and Brian Chaplin, are back together and actively working on new material. The brothers, known for their unique blend of electronic and rock music, initially disbanded in 2017 to pursue individual projects. This reunion represents a full-circle moment for the pair, who first gained prominence in 2010 with their hit single “Sunburn.”
A Pause for Individual Exploration
Following their split, both Andrew and Brian embarked on separate creative journeys. Andrew focused on his work as a producer, while Brian delved into solo musical endeavors and explored acting opportunities. This period of individual growth allowed each brother to hone their skills and gain new perspectives, ultimately contributing to a renewed appreciation for their collaborative dynamic.
“It was important for both of us to explore our individual passions,” a source close to the band explained. “The time apart allowed them to come back together with a clearer understanding of what they each bring to the table.”
Rekindling the Musical Groove
The decision to reunite wasn’t a sudden one, but rather a gradual realization of the unique musical chemistry they share. The brothers began collaborating remotely during the COVID-19 pandemic, which ultimately sparked a desire to officially rejoin forces.
According to reports, the duo has been spending considerable time in the studio, experimenting with new sounds and refining their signature style. They are aiming to deliver a sound that honors their past successes while pushing creative boundaries. The brothers are reportedly excited about the new direction of their music, describing it as a blend of their established sound with influences from contemporary electronic music.
What’s Next for Locnville?
Locnville is currently finalizing details for their upcoming releases, with plans to share new music with fans in the coming months. The band is also exploring opportunities for live performances, aiming to reconnect with their audience and showcase their revitalized energy.
The reunion of Locnville is not just a comeback story; it’s a testament to the enduring power of sibling bonds and the transformative potential of creative collaboration. Their return to the music scene is anticipated to be a significant event for fans and industry observers alike, promising a vibrant new era for the celebrated South African duo.
